integrity: The embedding-tensor identity is reduced to a volume-form equation and solved by rank without characteristic-dependent division. The Fundamental Identity of the model is checked directly, and exhaustive finite-field replay over F2 and F3 confirms the complete rank classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the fixed three-dimensional model [e1,e2,e3]=e1.
No quotient by the automorphism group is computed.
The uniqueness of the nontrivial three-dimensional algebra is invoked only over the complex field, as stated in the supporting classification source.
title: Adjoint embedding tensors on the three-dimensional \(3\)-Lie algebra
